title: Create Category & Pin
description: Learn how to create a new category and drop your first pin on the map. Categories help you organize your locations into logical groups like offices, warehouses, or field sites.

title: Update & Delete Pins
description: Manage your existing pins — edit their details, change categories, or remove them from the map entirely. Keep your data accurate and up-to-date.

title: Show All Pins
description: View all your deployed pins in one consolidated list. Quickly browse, search, and jump to any location on the map.

title: Delete Category
description: Remove an entire category and all its associated pins from your map. Use this to clean up unused or outdated groupings.

title: Reset Map Position
description: Fly back to your default map view instantly. You can also set a custom default position using the crosshair button.

title: Zoom In & Navigate
description: Zoom into specific regions to see pin density and explore areas in detail. Use scroll or pinch gestures for smooth navigation.

title: Submit Feedback
description: Share your thoughts, report bugs, or suggest new features directly from the app. Your feedback helps us improve MapFlow.
